# AutoStacc

> AutoStacc sells and delivers sample packs, presets, stems, music and visuals from the projects that make them, and keeps everything you own sorted in Your Stacc.

AutoStacc is the site at https://autostacc.com: a store and a library in one. Projects (artists and creators) make music, samples, presets, stems and visuals; AutoStacc sells and delivers them and keeps what each customer owns organized. A project is never the site; each one has its own pages under https://autostacc.com/projects/<project>.

## Platform

- [Home](https://autostacc.com/): new releases, projects and how AutoStacc works
- [Store](https://autostacc.com/shop): digital downloads, delivered right after checkout (payments by Stripe)
- [About](https://autostacc.com/about): how AutoStacc works and what its words mean
- [Projects](https://autostacc.com/projects): every project on AutoStacc

## Words

- Your Stacc: a customer's library of everything they own, from every project.
- Stacclet: a collection of related Pacs from one project.
- Pac: a folder of content (MIDI, samples, loops, presets and more).
- Auto-Stacc: adds a followed project's free releases to Your Stacc automatically; paid content is never added without buying it.

## Projects

### Glitches & Stitches

> An electronic music project that treats unfinished songs as raw material: fragments are torn out, stitched into new tracks and glitched into something new.

- [Home](https://autostacc.com/projects/glitches-and-stitches)

- [News](https://autostacc.com/projects/glitches-and-stitches/news)

Releases:

- [HAIL](https://autostacc.com/projects/glitches-and-stitches/music/hail) (single, 2025-10-15): HAIL is a single by Glitches & Stitches, released on 15 October 2025. One track, 2:27, streaming on Apple Music, YouTube Music and Deezer.
